verdict.rationale: Shopify's Tap to Pay docs say it accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets on a smartphone, so the contactless and mobile-wallet parts of the story are covered. Nothing in the evidence documents chip (EMV) insertion, and an older community comment said the product still needed EMV support; that is an unaddressed gap rather than a dispute, because the vendor never claims chip support. Missing for 10: documented chip/EMV card acceptance (e.g., a card reader), in-depth first-party payment docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
